title: AI Metrology Center metric submission, format 1.x
description: Machine-readable counterpart to SUBMISSION_FORMAT.md. One schema per MAJOR version: because MINOR bumps are backwards-compatible, every 1.x file is validated against this file. When the format changes, update this schema in the same pull request as SUBMISSION_FORMAT.md.

schema_version.description: The schema version this file follows. Add each newly released 1.x version to this list.

name.description: Formal name of the quantitative/qualitative measure or measurement methodology.

applied_definition.description: Precise mathematical or textual description of the metric or measurement method.

submitter_organizations.description: The entity or institution responsible for the submission.

contact_email.$comment: The placeholder guard used by `text` does not fit here: it requires a space between the angle brackets, and the template's own `<name@example.org>` has none — so it matched the address pattern and passed. No real address contains an angle bracket, so refusing them outright catches the unreplaced placeholder, and reuses the wording the other placeholder errors get.
contact_email.description: Professional point of contact for verification.

primary_tevv_application.description: Methodology, tool type, or mathematical approach.

enum: Automated Language Model Red Teaming Toolkit

ai_lifecycle_stages.description: Phase(s) in the AI lifecycle where the metric or method is applied, one stage per entry.

model_specificity.description: Either 'model agnostic', or 'model specific' plus which architectures.

domain_specificity.description: Either 'domain agnostic', or 'domain specific' plus which domain(s).

usage_details.description: Details or scenarios where the metric or method provides the most value.

known_failure_modes.description: Scenarios where the metric or method may be misleading or easily gamed.

references.description: Citations of peer-reviewed literature or NIST resources.

implementation_resources.description: Links to software, data, or other online resources implementing the approach.

related_metrics.description: Complementary metrics to be measured in tandem.

text.$comment: `not.pattern` rejects unreplaced <angle-bracket placeholders> copied from the template — angle brackets around text containing a space. It does not match `<b>` or `<0.5`.
